backstory:
Pascal Warner, brother of Patrick Warner Jr. (Deceased) and Peter Yakum Warner, is a generous man. He tends to spend his free time helping others in whatever ways he can, whether that be volunteering at the local Pharasmite church as a sub-deacon, helping cook as his brother’s restaurant, assisting the local hospital as a midwife, helping the town as a guardsman, or just generally helping people around town with small tasks. Some lean towards drugs or exercise as a crutch for normalizing their emotional state. Pascal leans on helping others, he uses that to distract himself from his life’s problems.
Pascal, like his family, is a devout follower of the typical Lok’holt pantheon. But, unlike his family he tends to favor Pharasma much more than the others slightly more than the others. Clearly Pascal is somewhat loved by Desna as well, because as a child he was always just a tad bit unluckier than most children. Recently, during the Void bloom incident, something changed in Pascal. His karmic balance was rewritten, his luck was so good in such a short span of time, that it must have dried the well and turned all his future luck outwards. Pascal is now extraordinarily unlucky, but those around him now tend to be luckier as a result.
Pascal was raised in a wealthy family, where money was never an issue. Pascal got everything he wanted, whenever he wanted. Except for attention from his parents, who were always busy working, volunteering, or spending time with his 2 elder brothers. Even after becoming a guardsman, as a celebration his parents gave him enough to buy his own house (actually quite a bit more, but Pascal used that to buy the highest quality equipment he could find).
In his youth, Pascal was a bit of a mischievous lad. Because he was somewhat starved for attention by his parents who tended to focus more on his 2 elder brothers. So, he was always playing harmless pranks on his neighbors, such as: drawing crude images on his neighbors property, constantly making jokes about his arse to his neighbors, or pushing people into piles of animal excrement. Overnight Pascal’s mischief suddenly stopped, after he pranked a single mother so hard she went into a deep depression and neglected her child. Pascal helped cook and clean her house for weeks, where he learned the value of a hard day's work. After this, Pascal made it his goal to become an adult worthy of respect. To accomplish this, he set out to become a town guard.
Due to his upbringing, Pascal Warner tends to focus more on the good in people than the bad. He tends to excuse quite a bit of rudeness directed at him and even hostility, but if it’s directed at a loved one Pascal’s kindness transforms into an uncontainable rage. He can’t dare to lose another loved one.
During the Gorthal incident, Pascal housed and protected Patrick and his family. It almost passed without incident, except on the penultimate day of the Gorthal incident, when Patrick Warner Jr. was playing outside and was spotted by a Gorthal infected individual. Upon noticing Patrick the third was gone, Pascal warned everyone to stay put and declared he would find the boy. Unfortunately, no one listened and they all followed him. Pascal managed to arrive in the nick of time and save the boy, but in his haste he failed to notice he was being tailed by Patrick the third’s parents. He couldn’t save them. Their minds became corrupted by Gorthal. They were out for blood. He had to kill them to save the child. He had no other option. Pascal realizes this and yet, he can never forgive himself. They say time heals all wounds, but not this one. Even Patrick the third, after only a few weeks of grieving forgave Pascal. But Pascal, he’ll take this one regret to the grave. Pascal assisted in the healthy birth of Patrick, if he also assisted in his death he would never recover.
One could say that the Gorthal incident transformed Pascal the most. His personality essentially became that of a martyr. He goes out of his way to help others, regardless of the personal risk he puts himself into. Pascal’s goal is to become the next guard captain, or at least his right hand man and help turn Lok’holt into a Utopia where children won’t be orphaned and everyone is good natured. Of course, Pascal isn’t an idiot, he knows that is impossible. He just wants to atone for his sins in any way he can. Of course, he’ll never bring up this fact to anyone, especially not Patrick
